subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should the Models card present exact-name totals across provider histories that may overlap, or must the feature define a deduplication/non-overlap boundary before showing a cross-provider aggregate?
rationale: The related design discussion identifies canonical identity and double-counting as core product constraints; code review cannot safely choose the permanent accounting contract.

options.title: Require an overlap boundary
options.body: Keep provider provenance but avoid or qualify aggregate totals until source overlap can be excluded or explicitly modeled.

options.title: Approve the constrained MVP
options.body: Accept exact normalized-name aggregation without deduplication as a clearly documented token-only exploratory view.

options.title: Pause Scope B
options.body: Defer the cross-provider card until maintainers choose canonicalization and double-counting policy.

recommendation.title: Require an overlap boundary
recommendation.body: Keep provider provenance but avoid or qualify aggregate totals until source overlap can be excluded or explicitly modeled.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and accounting-semantics decision.
